title: Make words behave according to their meaning
summary: Build an editable planning field whose marked words have distinct physical responses without sacrificing text editing.
originNote: Distilled from a history-derived creative-code pattern where semantic tokens become manipulable objects rather than decorative highlights.

setup.instructions: Mount the token packet. Build a self-contained editable artifact with no external libraries or network requests.

turns.content: Read fixtures/tokens.json and implement a complete responsive editable planning field as index.html. The user must be able to edit, select, copy, and keyboard-navigate the text normally. The four marked words should each have a distinct interaction response derived from their meaning; dragging through the field may displace rendered tokens, but it must not corrupt the text or steal ordinary click-to-edit. Provide a clear reset and a motion-reduced mode in which semantic state remains visible without particles or displacement. Give each marked token data-token equal to its lowercase word.

Revise the artifact so a simple click, caret move, selection drag, and keyboard edit remain primary. Require a deliberate modifier or explicit interaction mode for physical displacement. Preserve the semantic responses and the existing visual direction.

checks.description: All four semantic token identities and an editable control are present.
Edit and select text, then enter the displacement mode and verify that the source text remains unchanged.
